A gallery of twenty 3D primitives
3D surface plot — drag to orbit
Two sugar-phosphate backbones built as stroked paths, antiparallel, with base pairs between them. #biology #dna #path
A single RNA strand whose every base position is a function of time, so the molecule flexes rather than sitting still. #biology #rna #animated
A replication fork opening in 3D while a particle pool of ninety free nucleotides drifts around it. #biology #dna #particles #3d
Drag a polymerase along a gene; the mRNA transcript grows behind it and the percentage transcribed updates live. #biology #rna #interactive
Three atoms as panels of proton, neutron and electron counts, laid out so the comparison is structural rather than drawn. #chemistry #atoms #layout
One row per pass, placed elements highlighted, so the whole algorithm is visible at once instead of animated and gone. #computing #algorithms #sorting
Twelve tectonic plates by speed in centimetres per year, plotted from a float array. The fast ones are oceanic. #earth #tectonics #chart
Quantity demanded over price and income as a single computed mesh with turning 3D axes. Constant elasticity, so the surface curves. #economics #demand #3d #surface

Each dot is a buyer placed at the most they will pay. A sweeping price line cuts through both populations; the tightly packed elastic band empties at once while the spread inelastic one barely notices. #economics #elasticity #particles
Drag to change the budget and watch spending shares move between necessities and luxuries. #economics #consumer #interactive
The same three questions answered four ways, as a typographic table: sellers, product, price power. #economics #competition #text

t: Four-bar linkage and its coupler curve
d: A four-bar linkage frozen at one angle, with the coupler point's full locus traced as a closed path. #engineering #mechanism #path
Integers from -5 to 5 with halves marked and pi placed where it actually falls. A typography document: the labels carry the meaning. #maths #numbers #text
Twelve fermions on a log mass axis, quarks against leptons, plotted from a float array. The three neutrinos fall below the axis entirely. #physics #particles #chart
A reflowing card layout of the six quark flavours with their electric charges, and a note on gluon colour. Built from layout containers, no canvas. #physics #particles #layout
Two up quarks and one down inside the confining volume, each with a wireframe colour-charge halo, joined by gluon bonds drawn as vibrating standing waves. #physics #particles #3d #animated
Drag across to cross-fade between the two; shared organelles stay put so only the differences move. #biology #cells #interactive
A 3D cell with a bitmap-textured nucleus, organelles placed inside it and a wireframe membrane cage. #biology #cells #3d #texture
A ribosome walking the message codon by codon, the polypeptide growing behind it and tRNA arriving at the A site. Every position is a function of one clock. #biology #rna #animated
Transcription factors as a particle cloud; the more tightly they bind, the further transcription rises. #biology #genetics #particles

t: Atomic radius over the periodic table
d: The table's grid is already two axes, so the third carries atomic radius. The sawtooth across each period is invisible on a flat table. #chemistry #periodic #3d #chart
Looking for 23 in ten sorted elements, one row of boxes per step, the live window narrowing down the page. #computing #algorithms #search
Igneous, sedimentary and metamorphic joined by curved arrow paths: weathering, heat and pressure, melting. #earth #geology #path

t: GDP as an identity you can push on
d: C plus I plus G plus NX, with investment under your finger and the total following. #economics #gdp #interactive
The same five goods priced across five decades, set as a table with the money column aligned. #economics #inflation #text

t: The same market, split four ways
d: One ball is one firm and its area is that firm's market share; every panel holds the same total area. Perfect competition to monopoly. #economics #competition #particles
Two meshing gears from a single clock: the second angle is the first times the tooth ratio, so they cannot drift out of step. #engineering #gears #animated
Halves, quarters, sixths and eighths on a shared width, every bar filling to the same line. #maths #fractions #demonstrate
The four forces on one log axis, with their ranges and carriers. Gravity is 10^38 times weaker than the strong force, which is why its bar is a sliver. #physics #forces #compare
Annihilation, scattering and beta decay as cards, each pairing a small canvas with its caption. Time runs left to right. #physics #particles #layout
The Livingston plot: beam energy per machine on a log axis, a factor of ten every six years for seventy years, with bunches circulating alongside. #physics #accelerators #chart
Four tracks leaving a vertex, curving by charge and momentum, drawn as 2D paths inside a wireframe 3D chamber. #physics #particles #3d #path
Passive and active transport side by side on one clock, so the rates are comparable: down the gradient is free, against it costs ATP. #biology #membrane #animated
Sixteen chromosomes scattering, lining up on the metaphase plate, then separating to the poles - position encodes the phase. #biology #mitosis #particles
Drag to run both divisions: one diploid cell becomes four haploid ones, in 3D so the two splits stay distinguishable. #biology #meiosis #3d #interactive
A cascade is a numbers argument, so it is set as a table: one hormone molecule ends up moving ten million enzymes. #biology #signalling #text
Subshells in filling order against energy level, with the crossing that puts the transition metals where they are. #chemistry #electrons #chart
A recursive factorial where the layout containers ARE the recursion: each box is a call waiting for the one inside it. #computing #recursion #layout
Shield, stratovolcano and cinder cone as filled paths on one baseline and one scale - the shapes are the comparison. #earth #volcanoes #path

Rotation in, straight-line motion out. The slider's travel is computed exactly from the rod length, not faked with a sine, which is why a piston dwells longer at one end. #engineering #mechanism #animated
Ninety holdings as a particle scatter by risk, return and sector. Drag to turn it: the rotation is applied to each point before projecting it. #finance #portfolio #3d #interactive #particles
Drag the yield and watch a bond's price move the other way along the price-yield curve. A 5% coupon pays par only when yields are 5%. #finance #bonds #interactive
Six commodity futures with their venues, contract sizes and quoting units - a price move means a different amount of money in each row. #finance #commodities #text
Primes below 576 as towers on a 24 by 24 grid, where the composite gaps fall into diagonal lanes. #maths #primes #3d
First ionization energy against atomic number. Peaks are full shells, troughs are the next shell starting - the sawtooth IS the shell structure. #physics #atoms #chart
Orbital cross-sections drawn as closed paths rather than approximated by circles. #physics #orbitals #path
Three flavour probabilities oscillating with distance over energy, always summing to one: a neutrino is never lost, only changed. #physics #neutrinos #chart

The Mexican-hat potential as a 3D surface inside a card layout: the centre is a hill, the brim is the ground state, and mass is the cost of moving through the occupied field. #physics #higgs #3d #layout
